prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sheet, The Unstable Lab. Use the original reference PNGs for the established organic full-body ink monster morphology and modeling. Exactly six whole independent standalone dark charcoal-plum goo figures, three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Every face is sculpted directly into its continuous organic blob. Think six different compact asymmetrical drips, rounded pears, commas and irregular splats, as varied as the original family. Maintain each individual silhouette, with natural soft little lobes at the sides and bottom, sometimes no distinct foot shape. A short round or tapered bottom is welcome. Do not use a standard flared base, wide flat skirt, common lobe row, humanoid chest or cut-off bust. Clothing is just a small removable accessory and props sit close to the side or belly with the lower body visible. Thick sculpted dark lids, white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Soft satin clay, sparse broad hand modeling marks, distinct moods, tiny ink hands. No inherited costume, wing or eyepatch, scenery, floor, shadow, frame or text beyond specified prop marks. Preserve generous transparent separation and exterior margin. Cobalt, pale yellow and moss with tiny lab and workshop accents.
Row-major roles:
1. Male-read mathematics teacher. low rounded diamond, intent narrow eyes. Key cue: wooden circle divided into three visible fraction wedges.
2. Female-read physics teacher. tall bent drop, astonished upturned gaze. Key cue: short little tabletop pendulum with one solid swinging bob.
3. Male-read chemistry teacher. round uneven blob, alert eyes, quiet grin. Key cue: small clean conical glass flask half full of smooth mint liquid.
4. Male-read biology teacher. low fan shaped blob, open curious expression. Key cue: large leaf and one compact magnifier held against its vein.
5. Female-read computer science teacher. upright squared splat, stubborn side-eye. Key cue: palm-sized board with a chunky closed circuit loop and button.
6. Male-read technology teacher. wide drooping bean, skeptical brow and lopsided mouth. Key cue: two thick wood gears meshed on a tiny handle.
Each actor has a distinct complete compact ink contour from crown to lower edge and one clean readable subject or role prop.
